authenticity.evidence: 2,128 unique buyers against only 135 unique sellers, with 4,597 sells. That means a small set of wallets is doing heavy repeated selling, which looks like bots or wash trading. GMGN flags 100 bundler wallets, although the top bundler share is only 5.1%. There are no smart-money or KOL wallets, no DexScreener paid promotion and no dex profile. The buyer burst was concentrated: 1,155 buyers over the last 30 minutes but only 116 over the last 15. That fits a short wave of attention rather than steady organic growth. The X handle has no rename history, which is a mild positive.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X or Telegram content is visible, so I can't tell whether a real cat video or meme is behind this or whether it is a manufactured launch.

structured_output.counterargument: Three deploys under the same name within about 20 minutes, one of which printed roughly $1.4M of volume, suggest a real meme moment (a viral 'cat afloat' clip). This pair looks like the one the market chose as canonical, since it has $35k liquidity and a working website, X and Telegram. If the meme keeps spreading on X, a $128k coin with healthy liquidity and 2k+ holders can easily retest its ATH near $280k and go past it. The 14-36% short-term dip may be a normal shakeout before the second leg.
